written.headline: Democrats launch Nvidia investigation into China chip sales and Trump deal
written.summary: Congressional Democrats launched an inquiry into how the Trump administration handled Nvidia's chip sales to China following the ouster of CEO Jensen Huang. Lawmakers questioned a revenue-sharing agreement and export licenses involving the Commerce Department.

written.headline: Forensic analysis finds six Chinese AI models show NVIDIA Blackwell GPU fingerprints
written.summary: A forensic study of publicly released AI model weights identified hardware fingerprints matching NVIDIA’s export‑controlled Blackwell GPUs in six models from DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, MiniMax and Ant Group released since April 2026. The analysis suggests these Chinese developers have accessed the latest NVIDIA chips despite U.S. export restrictions.

written.headline: Anthropic IPO draws about six times the orders for available shares
written.summary: Anthropic’s IPO is about six times oversubscribed, with the company seeking up to $64.4 billion in the offering and targeting a $1.4 trillion valuation; existing backers will be prioritized.

written.headline: Nebius outlines $40‑45 billion 2027 capex plan funded by customer pre‑payments
written.summary: Nebius announced it will spend $40‑45 billion on capital expenditures in 2027, aiming to add over 1 GW of AI cloud capacity. The funding will rely on $10‑20 billion of customer pre‑payments and contract‑backed loans, with a major Microsoft contract worth up to $19.4 billion at risk due to delays.

written.headline: President Trump urges Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to keep fighting for his job
written.summary: President Donald Trump called Jensen Huang on Tuesday, telling him to keep fighting for his position after reports of a relationship with a suspected Chinese spy. Trump said he believes Huang had no knowledge of the alleged espionage.

written.headline: Google DeepMind launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a fast low‑cost model for coding
written.summary: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a language model priced at $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens. The model outperforms Anthropic’s Claude Sonnet 5.5 on seven of ten internal benchmarks and runs 2.5 × faster than Gemini 3.8 Flash.
